points.title: 成长与创作启蒙
points.description: 简·奥斯汀出生于英国汉普郡史蒂文顿的一个牧师家庭，是家中八个孩子中的第七个。在这个宁静的乡村环境中，她接受了良好的家庭教育，父亲乔治·奥斯汀是当地牧师，母亲卡桑德拉来自一个较为富裕的家庭。奥斯汀从小就展现出对文学的热爱，经常阅读父亲图书馆中的书籍。这一时期，她开始创作短篇小说和戏剧，并完成了她的早期作品《爱情与友谊》等。史蒂文顿的乡村生活为她后来的小说提供了丰富的素材和观察视角，尤其是对乡村社会、婚姻制度和女性地位的深刻理解。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Steventon, Hampshire, to a clergyman family with eight children, Jane Austen received a good home education in this peaceful rural environment. Her father, George Austen, was the local rector, and her mother, Cassandra, came from a relatively wealthy family. From a young age, Austen showed a love for literature, often reading books from her father's library. During this period, she began writing short stories and plays, completing early works like 'Love and Friendship.' The rural life in Steventon provided rich material and observational perspectives for her later novels, particularly her deep understanding of country society, marriage institutions, and women's positions.

points.title: 都市生活与创作转型
points.description: 1801年，奥斯汀随父母移居巴斯，这座温泉城市成为她生活的重要转折点。在巴斯，奥斯汀接触到了更为广阔的社会圈层，观察到了更多样化的社会阶层和人际关系。这段都市生活经历极大地丰富了她的创作素材，使她对社会的观察更加敏锐和深刻。虽然奥斯汀个人并不完全适应巴斯的生活，但她将这座城市的社交氛围、婚姻观念和阶级差异融入了后来的作品中，如《劝导》和《曼斯菲尔德庄园》。在巴斯期间，奥斯汀经历了创作上的短暂停滞，但这段经历为她后期作品的成熟奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1801, Austen moved with her parents to Bath, a spa town that became a significant turning point in her life. In Bath, Austen was exposed to a broader social circle, observing more diverse social classes and interpersonal relationships. This urban experience greatly enriched her creative material, making her social observations more acute and profound. Although Austen did not fully adapt to Bath's lifestyle, she integrated the city's social atmosphere, marriage concepts, and class differences into her later works, such as 'Persuasion' and 'Mansfield Park.' During her time in Bath, Austen experienced a brief creative hiatus, but this period laid the foundation for the maturity of her later works.

points.title: 创作黄金期
points.description: 1809年，奥斯汀回到家乡附近的乔顿，与姐姐卡桑德拉同住在兄弟爱德华提供的房子里。这是她创作生涯中最 productive 的时期。在乔顿，奥斯汀完成了她最著名的六部小说中的四部：《傲慢与偏见》、《爱玛》、《曼斯菲尔德庄园》和《劝导》。这一时期，她的作品逐渐获得了出版和认可，尽管她最初选择匿名出版。乔顿的宁静环境为奥斯汀提供了理想的创作条件，使她能够专注于对社会现象的观察和文学创作。她的小说以其精湛的叙事技巧、敏锐的社会洞察力和对女性命运的深刻关怀而著称，成为英国文学史上的经典之作。
points.descriptionEn: In 1809, Austen returned to Chawton near her hometown, living with her sister Cassandra in a house provided by their brother Edward. This was the most productive period of her writing career. In Chawton, Austen completed four of her most famous six novels: 'Pride and Prejudice,' 'Emma,' 'Mansfield Park,' and 'Persuasion.' During this time, her works gradually gained publication and recognition, although she initially chose to publish anonymously. The tranquil environment of Chawton provided ideal conditions for Austen to focus on observing social phenomena and literary creation. Her novels are renowned for their exquisite narrative skills, keen social insight, and profound concern for women's destinies, becoming classics in English literary history.

points.title: 最后岁月与逝世
points.description: 1816年，奥斯汀的健康状况开始恶化，被诊断出患有 Addison病。为了寻求更好的医疗照顾，她搬到温彻斯特。尽管身体状况不佳，奥斯汀仍然坚持写作，完成了《桑迪顿》的开头部分，这部作品在她去世时尚未完成。1817年7月18日，简·奥斯汀在温彻斯特去世，年仅41岁。她的葬礼在温彻斯特大教堂举行，被安葬在北通道的家族墓穴中。奥斯汀的早逝使英国文学失去了一位极具才华的作家，但她的作品在她去世后逐渐获得了更广泛的认可和影响力，成为世界文学宝库中的珍贵遗产。
points.descriptionEn: In 1816, Austen's health began to deteriorate, diagnosed with Addison's disease. Seeking better medical care, she moved to Winchester. Despite her poor health, Austen continued to write, completing the beginning of 'Sanditon,' which remained unfinished at her death. On July 18, 1817, Jane Austen died in Winchester at the age of 41. Her funeral was held at Winchester Cathedral, and she was buried in the family vault in the north aisle. Austen's early death deprived English literature of an exceptionally talented writer, but her works gradually gained wider recognition and influence after her death, becoming a precious heritage in the world's literary treasure.

points.title: 出版与认可
points.description: 尽管奥斯汀的大部分创作生涯在乡村度过，但伦敦作为英国的文化中心，对她作品的出版和传播起到了关键作用。1811年，她的第一部出版作品《理智与情感》在伦敦匿名出版，署名为'一位女士'。随后，《傲慢与偏见》(1813)、《曼斯菲尔德庄园》(1814)和《爱玛》(1815)相继在伦敦出版，均采用匿名方式。奥斯汀亲自参与了出版过程，与出版商协商，甚至亲自校对样书。尽管她的作品在世时获得了商业成功，但文学界的认可相对有限。直到1818年，在她去世后出版的《诺桑觉寺》和《劝导》才首次署上了她的真名。伦敦的出版经历使奥斯汀的作品得以广泛传播，为她赢得了读者群，也为她后来的文学地位奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Although most of Austen's writing career was spent in the countryside, London, as the cultural center of England, played a crucial role in the publication and dissemination of her works. In 1811, her first published work, 'Sense and Sensibility,' was anonymously published in London under the byline 'By a Lady.' Subsequently, 'Pride and Prejudice' (1813), 'Mansfield Park' (1814), and 'Emma' (1815) were published in London, all anonymously. Austen personally participated in the publication process, negotiating with publishers and even proofreading the manuscripts herself. Although her works achieved commercial success during her lifetime, literary recognition was relatively limited. It was not until 1818, with the posthumous publication of 'Northanger Abbey' and 'Persuasion,' that her real name appeared for the first time. Her London publishing experience allowed her works to be widely disseminated, earning her a readership and laying the foundation for her later literary status.

supporter.zh: 奥斯汀被赞誉为英国文学史上最伟大的女性作家之一，她的作品以其精湛的艺术技巧和对人性的深刻洞察而著称。支持者认为奥斯汀通过细腻的笔触揭示了19世纪英国社会的真实面貌，尤其是女性在婚姻、财产和社会地位方面的困境。她的小说不仅具有娱乐价值，更蕴含着对社会不公的温和批判和对女性独立意识的肯定。奥斯汀创造的伊丽莎白·班纳特、爱玛·伍德豪斯等女性形象成为文学史上的经典，影响了后世无数作家。
supporter.en: Austen is celebrated as one of the greatest female writers in English literary history, renowned for her exquisite artistic techniques and profound insight into human nature. Supporters argue that through her delicate brushstrokes, Austen revealed the true face of 19th-century British society, particularly the predicaments of women regarding marriage, property, and social status. Her novels not only possess entertainment value but also contain gentle critiques of social injustice and affirmations of female consciousness. The female characters she created, such as Elizabeth Bennet and Emma Woodhouse, have become classics in literary history, influencing countless subsequent writers.

critic.zh: 批评者指出奥斯汀的作品存在明显的局限性，她的视野主要局限于英国乡村中上阶层社会，很少涉及更广阔的社会问题和政治议题。她的小说被认为过于关注婚姻和财产，缺乏对社会变革的关注。此外，奥斯汀对当时正在进行的工业革命和奴隶制等重大社会问题几乎保持沉默。一些批评者还认为她的作品过于保守，强化了传统的性别角色和社会等级制度。尽管奥斯汀的作品在艺术上成就卓越，但批评者认为她的社会视野相对狭窄，未能充分反映时代的复杂性。
critic.en: Critics point out that Austen's works have significant limitations, with her perspective largely confined to the middle and upper classes of rural British society, rarely addressing broader social and political issues. Her novels are considered overly focused on marriage and property, lacking attention to social change. Additionally, Austen remained almost silent on major contemporary issues such as the ongoing Industrial Revolution and slavery. Some critics also argue that her works are too conservative, reinforcing traditional gender roles and social hierarchies. Despite their artistic achievements, critics maintain that Austen's social perspective was relatively narrow, failing to fully reflect the complexity of her era.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，奥斯汀的作品超越了时代限制，成为全球文化现象。她的小说被翻译成多种语言，并被改编成无数电影、电视剧和舞台剧。在学术界，奥斯汀研究成为专门的领域，学者们从女性主义、后殖民主义、新历史主义等多种角度解读她的作品。奥斯汀本人也成为文化符号，代表着优雅、智慧和独立精神。她的名言'只有单身女性才能真正了解自己的心'成为女性主义运动的经典引言。奥斯汀的作品不仅反映了19世纪初英国社会的风貌，更因其对人性和社会关系的永恒洞察而持续影响着当代读者。
objective.en: From historical and popular culture perspectives, Austen's works have transcended temporal limitations, becoming a global cultural phenomenon. Her novels have been translated into multiple languages and adapted into numerous films, TV series, and stage plays. Academically, Austen studies have become a specialized field, with scholars interpreting her works from various perspectives including feminism, postcolonialism, and new historicism. Austen herself has become a cultural symbol representing elegance, wisdom, and independent spirit. Her famous quote 'A single woman of large fortune is always respectable' has become a classic引用 in feminist movements. Austen's works not only reflect the social landscape of early 19th-century Britain but continue to influence contemporary readers due to their timeless insights into human nature and social relationships.

self.zh: 一个拥有大笔财富的单身女子，总是值得尊敬的。
self.en: A single woman of large fortune is always respectable.

others.zh: 奥斯汀小姐的作品中最卓越的品质是，她对人物性格的描绘如此真实，以至于读者似乎在现实生活中认识这些人。
others.en: The most wonderful quality in Miss Austen's works is that her portraits of character are so true that the reader seems to know these people in real life.
